title: Pinnatifid
summary: PIN'NATIFID, adjective [Latin pinna, a fether, and findo, to cleave.] In botany, fether-cleft. A pinnatifid leaf is a species of simple leaf, divided transversely by oblong horizontal segments or jags

inlines.v: PIN'NATIFID, adjective [Latin pinna, a fether, and findo, to cleave.] In botany, fether-cleft. A pinnatifid leaf is a species of simple leaf, divided transversely by oblong horizontal segments or jags, not extending to the mid rib.
